snippet.title: Haypi Monster - The Lost Tower - v2.0 trailer
snippet.description:
Download The Lost Tower in different languages:
German version: https://www.appannie.com/apps/ios/app/tfjoy-der-lost-tower-deutsch/
Dutch version: https://www.appannie.com/apps/ios/app/868628836/
Italian version: https://www.appannie.com/apps/ios/app/tfjoy-antica-torre-italia/
Russian version: https://www.appannie.com/apps/ios/app/tfjoy-lost-tower-russkij-server/
Spanish version: https://www.appannie.com/apps/ios/app/tfjoy-la-torre-perdida/
Follow Us on Facebook or VKontakte:
German version: https://www.facebook.com/DerLostTower
Dutch version: https://www.facebook.com/DeVerlorenToren
Italian version: https://www.facebook.com/TFJoy.AnticaTorre
Russian version: https://vk.com/lost.tower
Spanish version: https://www.facebook.com/LaTorrePerdida?fref=pb&hc_location=profile_browser
Haypi Monster: The Lost Tower is a cartoon style EDU game. Almost 200 different monsters are here, waiting for you to collect! Feed, breed and tame them with your heart and love, form your dream team to challenge the mysterious lost tower!
Features:
-A journey that brings significant challenges: Over a hundred levels lay across eight scenes in three modes. Every single one of them contains our hard-working design, come to test your power!
-A world where all kinds of monsters live: Cute, humble, dashing or even hilarious, nearly 200 endearing monsters for those who love to collect!
-A monster raising system that provides great joy: Train and raise your monsters to build your very own elite team, strengthen them through our unique evolution system. Your monsters will be hotter than ever!
-A fight that creates real excitement: Wisely use those well designed skills and talents to make every battle a unique one!
You will discover even more exciting features along the way!
